notes.title: Nominate Duck Simulator 2 for Labor of Love
notes.content:
[b]Another message?[/b]

Okay, this time it's not an update. As you may know, the Steam Awards 2023 are coming up, and we would be honored if you would nominate us for Labor of Love.

For those of you who haven’t heard, we’ve been working on our next game in the Duck Simulator franchise for quite some time now. But while we’ve been busy slaving away on yet another action-packed game, we’ve been taking lots of time to polish Duck Simulator 2 to be the best game it can be!

Since the Steam Awards just so happen to be around the corner, we’d love to have your nomination for the Labor of Love award! We don’t quite have the same chance compared to many other popular games out there, but if you really have enjoyed our work as of late, we’d be incredibly glad to have your support!

Whether or not you decide to vote for us, we’ve loved our time with all of you in our [url=https://discord.gg/XFZj7HJp46]Discord server[/url] (shameless plug) and we’re so happy to have such a great community! Duck Simulator 2 is officially two years old today, and we’ve got lots of plans for the future. You’ve all been amazing, and we’ll see you all around!

- Orius and Eliza

notes.title: Duck Simulator v2.2.1 Released
notes.content:
[b][h1]Another one?[/h1][/b]
Yep, another update. Here's the list of bugfixes this time.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where an error cutscene would play on first boot.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Prologue shop not adjusting in volume.
[*] Fixed a rare crash due to issues with the volume manager.
[/list]
As always, thank you for your continued support. Remember to join the Discord server if you haven't already, and we hope to see you again soon.

notes.title: Duck Simulator 2 v2.2.0 Released
notes.content:
[b]Happy 13 months and 4 days since the last update![/b] This is likely the final update coming to Duck Simulator 2, which brings a variety of changes that will help us out as we transition to Duck Simulator 3!

[list]
[*] Switched to Orius Games account system (achievements cross-save)
[*] Created new speedrun leaderboard
[*] Rewrote a whole bunch of stuff
[*] Tweaked final boss fights
[*] Removed right-clicking or pressing ALT returning to previous screen
[/list]
As always, be sure to join our [url=https://ducksimulator.com/discord]Discord server[/url] to hang out with us and take full advantage of these new features! Thanks for sticking around, and I hope to see you all soon!

[b]See y'all!
- Orius[/b]

notes.title: Duck Simulator 2 v2.1.2 Released
notes.content:
Hey there! [b]Wanna see the world's fastest update?[/b]

[list]

Boom. It's done. But as always, [url=https://ducksimulator.com/discord]check out our Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Duck Simulator 2 v2.1.1 Released
notes.content:
Man, and just when I thought that I was done with this game...

[list]
[*] Fixed a major bug that caused speedruns under four or even three minutes to be submitted.
[*] Fixed a bug where starting a new prologue game after buying scenery in a prior run caused the scenery to give out free coins despite not being purchased yet,
[/list]
This is what sleep deprivation and no caffeine does to a man.

See you all soon!
- Orius

notes.title: Duck Simulator 2 v2.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Hello, everybody!

First of all, [b]thank you for the insane support[/b]! We've reached over [b]80,000 units[/b] "purchased" and it's absolutely insane to see how the community has grown since our launch around nine months ago. And to thank you all for this momentous occasion, I've put together [i]one last hurrah[/i] before the big work on Duck Simulator 3 and other projects begin! I'm not sure how much more I can actually do with this game, so I am going to assume (though I have been wrong several times before) that [u]this is the final update[/u]. So without further ado, here are the (hopefully) final patch notes:

[list]
[*] Added an optional speedrun timer when starting from the prologue.
[*] You can now link your Discord account through our [url=https://ducksimulator.com/discord]official server[/url] to receive rewards!
[*] [strike][b][i]the door[/i][/b] now opens to those who prove themselves worthy...[/strike]
[*] Added "press any button to skip" text to cutscenes.
[/list]
[b]Ladies and gentlemen, this has been a GREAT run for a game I made for an school project![/b] Going from simply showing off to my fellow peers to thousands of random people online really does leave a positive impact on one's life, and I thank you all for the great times.

I'll see you all soon!

notes.title: Duck Simulator 2 v1.3.0 Released
notes.content:
This is probably one of the last major updates the game will be getting, but Duck Simulator 2 is not quite finished. [b]I have big news coming in the next day or two, so make sure to join the [url=https://ducksimulator.com/discord]Discord server[/url] so you won't miss out![/b] Here's the changelog for this version.
[list]
[*] Controller support
[*] Sensitivity options are available in the settings
[*] Amount of pizzas collected is now viewable in the New Game menu
[*] Changelog no longer shows up on first bootup
[*] Fifth wall cutscenes are now skippable
[*] Rearranged the main menu UI
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
Once again, I have a big announcement coming out soon. We're nearly at 1,000 members on the [url=https://ducksimulator.com/discord]Discord server[/url], so please join if you want to be one of the first to see the announcement and want to help support Duck Simulator's development! 

See you all soon!

notes.title: Vote for Duck Simulator 3 versus Duck Simulator 2 Multiplayer!
notes.content:
Basically, I've had about a two-week winter vacation from school. I've had a lot of time to think about what I should do with the franchise, especially now that [b]we've sold over 50,000 units![/b] For nearly the whole vacation, I've been trying to decide whether I would want to make [b]Duck Simulator 3[/b] and reach a bigger audience (this was just a school project I put on Steam!) or update Duck Simulator 2 with a [b]multiplayer campaign[/b]. And tonight I just realized that I was going about it all wrong, and should ask all of you what you think!

Should I begin work on Duck Simulator 3 in a few weeks, I would likely be able to promise a Summer 2022 release date. However, if I update Duck Simulator 2 with a multiplayer campaign then Duck Simulator 3 could be delayed as far as Winter 2022. The multiplayer campaign definitely wouldn't be any small addition, either! Either way, here's what you could expect from both.

[b]Duck Simulator 3[/b]

[list]
[*] A completely new game with a much longer story (2-4 hours compared to Duck Simulator 2's 30 minutes)
[*] An included multiplayer campaign, whether that be at launch or via an update
[*] Actual content after the main campaign ends
[/list]
[b]Duck Simulator 2 Multiplayer[/b]

[list]
[*] An update to the already existing Duck Simulator 2
[*] Up to four players per room in a game similar if not exact to "A Fable of Below"
[*] Three chapters, each about 20 minutes long (players can only play at their combined lowest chapter)
[/list]
[url=https://ducksimulator.com/discord][u][b]Join the official Discord server today and cast your votes![/b][/u][/url]

notes.title: Duck Simulator 2 v1.2.0 Released
notes.content:
Hey everybody! So, I just wanted to preface this changelog by giving a big thank you for all the support over the past few days! [b]In about a week, we've gone from 2,000 downloads to nearly 25,000 downloads[/b]! I have big plans for the future, but those must wait as I am currently writing this at 1 AM and need to catch some beauty sleep.

With all of that out of the way, here's the actual changelog. Thanks once again for everything, and make sure to check out our official [url=https://ducksimulator.com/discord]Discord server[/url] if you want to hang out!

[list]
[*] Added chapter selection for the campaign in the settings
[*] Added Bonuses menu to the original Duck Simulator
[*] Added splash text and footer text to main menu
[/list]

notes.title: Duck Simulator 2 v1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
This update just adds some very requested final finishes!

[list]
[*] Added checkpoints for each minigame of the final boss fight
[*] You can now left click or press enter to skip dialogue in the RPG section
[*] Fixed a bug where taller aspect ratios would have a bloated clicker scene
[/list]
I hope to update the game with something big when I get an idea. Thank you all for the great feedback!
